title: .agents/roadmap.json
description: Org roadmap in the HQ repo: outcomes that group feature items across repos. Every `items` entry is `<repo>:<id>` and must exist in exactly one repo's features.json (a repo label claimed by two files is ambiguous). Documentation-only: the validator checks `outcomes[].id` (unique), `outcomes[].items` and that refs resolve; `target` and its minItems are NOT enforced.
